describe.description: The creature is a quadrupedal hybrid shown in right-facing profile, standing on four thick legs. Its body, head, ears, and limbs are those of a brown bear covered in dense, shaggy brown fur with a lighter tan muzzle, while its entire dorsal surface from the shoulders to the rump is covered by a large, highly glossy, dark reddish-brown beetle exoskeleton. A long, dark, curved horn with small notches projects upward from the center of its forehead between the ears, and a second shorter pointed horn projects forward from the beetle plate behind the neck. The overall impression is a single bear-like mammal bearing the carapace and horns of a rhinoceros beetle.

describe.description: The creature is a large four-legged mammal with the body, head, and fur of a brown bear, shown in right profile. It has dense shaggy brown fur, a bear-like head with a lighter tan muzzle, small dark eyes, a black nose, small rounded ears, and four thick legs ending in broad paws with long claws. Covering its back from behind the neck to the rump is a glossy dark reddish-brown beetle-like shell, and a long glossy black curved horn with notches rises from the forehead.
